[[File:WardenSobeck-Counterattack.png|thumb|right|250px|Osi Sobeck was the warden of the prison known as the Citadel.]]
'''Warden''' was the title given to someone who served as the individual in control of a [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] was the warden of the infamous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] prison on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] known as [[Citadel/Legends|The Citadel]].<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>

[[Dewt Kluskine]] was once the warden of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] detention facility on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] before it was overrun by its inmates. Command of the facility was then passed to [[Moruth Doole]].

In the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Fenn Booda]] served as the warden of [[Desolation Alley]].
